Local symbols: $T_{\mathrm{int}}$ is integration temperature in $\mathrm K$; $e_n(T)$ is species internal energy; $c_{v,n}^{\mathrm{ref}}$ is its tabulated constant capacity;
$J$ is a rotational quantum number; $k_{\mathrm B}$ is Boltzmann's constant in $\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}$;
Angle brackets in the rotor formula mean a normalized
finite ensemble average. These additions are tracked in ISSUES.md.
### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Default `type: moist-mixture`; thermo options required.
Temperature inversions and heat capacities come from kintera.
Sound speed follows @eq-ch02-moist-mixture-speed; accuracy is limited by inversion tolerance.
:::

### Derivation

kintera's `DY->V` stores partial mass densities $\rho_n$, including dry air; snapy multiplies by
inverse molar masses to obtain $\tilde c_n=\rho_n/\mu_n$ in $\mathrm{mol\,m^{-3}}$.
The API tensor named `V` is neither cell volume nor molar concentration. This corrects the explanatory
sentence in the frozen notation file without changing its mathematical symbols.
At fixed composition, differentiate $p=\mathcal RT\sum_{n\in\{\mathrm d\}\cup\mathcal V}\tilde c_nZ_n$
with respect to total density. Since every concentration scales with density, the implemented diagonal
concentration derivative gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
c_T^2&=\frac{\mathcal RT}{\rho}\sum_{n\in\{\mathrm d\}\cup\mathcal V}
\tilde c_n\left(Z_n+\tilde c_n\frac{\partial Z_n}{\partial\tilde c_n}\right),\\
\gamma&=\frac{\rho_{\mathrm d}c_{p,\mathrm d}+\sum_n\rho_nc_{p,n}}
{\rho_{\mathrm d}c_{v,\mathrm d}+\sum_n\rho_nc_{v,n}},\\
c_s&=\sqrt{\gamma}\,c_T.
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch02-moist-mixture-speed}

@eq-ch02-moist-mixture-speed is implemented by `_adiabatic_index` in [`moist_mixture.cpp:245-272`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/moist_mixture.cpp#L245-L272).

At the ideal-gas pin $Z_n=1$, the speed reduces to $c_s^2=\gamma p/\rho$.
A general concentration-coupled nonideal mixture would require cross derivatives not represented by this formula.
For temperature recovery, linearize volumetric internal energy at fixed partial densities. Its derivative is
volumetric heat capacity, giving the update

$$
T\leftarrow T+
\frac{\rho e-\rho_{\mathrm d}e_{\mathrm d}(T)-\sum_n\rho_ne_n(T)}
{\rho_{\mathrm d}c_{v,\mathrm d}(T)+\sum_n\rho_nc_{v,n}(T)}
$$ {#eq-ch02-moist-mixture-newton}

@eq-ch02-moist-mixture-newton is implemented by `_intEng_to_temp` in [`kintera thermo_y.cpp:495-517`](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/c55b13b2204997d2d09e04498558ab9495d8ee77/src/thermo/thermo_y.cpp#L495-L517).

Here $e_n(T)$ is species specific internal energy in $\mathrm{J\,kg^{-1}}$.
The pressure inversion uses the residual $T\sum\tilde c_nZ_n-p/\mathcal R$ and subtracts it divided by
$\sum\rho_n(c_{p,n}-c_{v,n})/\mathcal R$ over gases. For $Z_n=1$ that denominator is the exact derivative,
and the initial ideal-gas estimate already solves the equation. The damping argument in the source comment
is conditional on the stated nonideal Mayer relation; no dissociation implementation is inferred from it.

For NASA-9, integrate each term of $c_{p,n}/R_n$ with respect to temperature to obtain
$\hat h_n/R_n$, then subtract $T$ to obtain internal energy. Referencing the integral to $300\,\mathrm K$
retains the existing energy zero:

$$
e_n(T)=u_n^\star+c_{v,n}^{\mathrm{ref}}\,300\,\mathrm K
+\int_{300\,\mathrm K}^{T}[c_{p,n}(T_{\mathrm{int}})-R_n]\,\mathrm dT_{\mathrm{int}}
$$ {#eq-ch02-moist-mixture-integral}

@eq-ch02-moist-mixture-integral is implemented by `intEng_nasa` in [`kintera eval_uhs.cpp:285-300`](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/c55b13b2204997d2d09e04498558ab9495d8ee77/src/thermo/eval_uhs.cpp#L285-L300).

The constant $c_{v,n}^{\mathrm{ref}}$
is the tabulated constant capacity, not its value after enabling NASA-9.

For molecular hydrogen, each rotational level $J$ has energy $k_{\mathrm B}T_{\mathrm{rot}}J(J+1)$.
The implementation sums levels from $0$ through $40$ with $T_{\mathrm{rot}}=87.55\,\mathrm K$.
Normalize the weights $(2J+1)\exp[-T_{\mathrm{rot}}J(J+1)/T]$ to obtain expectations.
Differentiating the mean rotational energy gives the variance formula

$$
\frac{c_{v,\mathrm H_2}}{R_{\mathrm H_2}}
=\frac32+\left(\frac{T_{\mathrm{rot}}}{T}\right)^2
\left(\langle[J(J+1)]^2\rangle-\langle J(J+1)\rangle^2\right)
$$ {#eq-ch02-moist-mixture-rotor}

@eq-ch02-moist-mixture-rotor is implemented by `h2_rot_reduce` in [`kintera eval_uhs.cpp:83-92`](https://github.com/chengcli/kintera/blob/c55b13b2204997d2d09e04498558ab9495d8ee77/src/thermo/eval_uhs.cpp#L83-L92).

Equilibrium mode multiplies odd-level weights by three. Normal mode averages separately normalized even and
odd ensembles with weights one quarter and three quarters, including their separate variances. Referencing
$\tfrac32T+T_{\mathrm{rot}}\langle J(J+1)\rangle$ to $300\,\mathrm K$ gives the energy correction.
The rotational sum is truncated at the coded level limit; no temperature-range error bound is measured here.
`moist-mixture_check.py` differentiates this energy numerically in both modes and checks a NASA polynomial
antiderivative and the ideal-gas Newton sign. This tests the formulas, not a compiled kintera run.

### Numerical method

`U->W` subtracts metric kinetic energy, constructs partial densities, calls `VU->T`, then `VT->P`.
`W->I`, `W->T`, `W->A` and `WA->L` refresh the cache if tensor identity or mutation version differs.
The operations are cell-local; the cache is not a stencil. Floors invalidate the conserved-to-primitive cache.
No spatial wall or seam accuracy order follows from a temperature inversion.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
Newton iteration warns on nonconvergence at its iteration limit and returns the current estimate; this is not the saturation
failure counter. `use-nasa9-cp` and `use-h2-cp` do not establish a matching phase-equilibrium closure.
H2 dissociation is not claimed. The requested compiled kintera heat-capacity plot remains missing evidence;
the formula check supplies no measured accuracy of the installed library.
Switch-combination coverage remains pending in @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
